planets.name: WASP-7 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-7 with a 4.95-day year, found in 2008.

text.card: WASP-7 b was found in 2008 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-7. Its orbit and size follow Southworth et al. 2011's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SOUTHWORTH_ET_AL__2011): disc_year 2008, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.95464865738, pl_radj 1.33, pl_bmassj 0.96

quotes.title: WASP-7 b
quotes.card: WASP-7 b is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008.
quotes.introduction: This 5-day period planet, orbiting a round the star WASP-7, is slightly smaller than Jupiter, roughly the same mass and more dense.
